title: Remembering Thomas Michele Withers
summary: The Mobile Sports Hall of Fame, the Mobile Alabama community, and his family mourn the loss of Thomas Michele Withers, an inaugural member of the Board of Directors.
body: The Mobile Sports Hall of Fame, the Mobile Alabama community, and his family mourn the loss of Thomas Michele Withers. Tom was an inaugural member of the Mobile Sports Hall of Fame Board of Directors. He left us on February 26, 2026.

title: 2025 Mobile Sports Hall of Fame Inductees
summary: Josh Donaldson, Mark Barron, Rodney Hudson, and Ivan Maisel make up the latest class of inductees.
body: 2015 American League Most Valuable Player Josh Donaldson, longtime NFL stars Mark Barron and Rodney Hudson, and renowned sports writer Ivan Maisel make up the latest Mobile Sports Hall of Fame class of inductees. Donaldson played 13 years in the major leagues, recording a career .261 batting average with 279 home runs and 816 RBI.

title: Outstanding Men and Women from Five Sports Make up the Class of 2019
summary: A World Series hero, the nation’s preeminent handicapper, and “the father of the Senior Bowl” are among this year’s inductees.
body: A World Series hero, the nation’s preeminent handicapper, and “the father of the Senior Bowl” are among the inductees into the Mobile Sports Hall of Fame—joined by a national champion football coach, an All-American volleyball star, and a legendary soccer coach.

title: Two-time Pro Bowler, Cy Young award winner top the Class of 2018
summary: Despite three Super Bowl rings and a pair of Pro Bowl appearances, one inductee is best known for two plays he’d like to forget.
body: Despite three Super Bowl rings and a pair of Pro Bowl appearances during an 11-year NFL career, one inductee is best known for two plays he’d like to forget. Another member of this year’s class has a Cy Young award in his trophy case.

title: 2017 Mobile Sports Hall of Fame Inductees are an “All-Star” Cast
summary: One inductee has multiple NBA championship rings, another is forever etched in Iron Bowl lore.
body: One inductee has multiple NBA championship rings, another is forever etched in Iron Bowl lore, and still another is considered among the best to ever play his position—plus a five-time Alabama high school Coach of the Year.

title: 2016 Mobile Sports Hall of Fame inductees is a banner group!
summary: Two Major League Baseball stars, a Division I championship quarterback, and more make up the 2016 class.
body: Two Major League Baseball stars, a Division I championship quarterback, a former PGA tour player, an All-American volleyball player, and one of the greatest high school basketball coaches in Alabama history make up the 2016 class.

title: Mayor Stimpson Endorses Mobile Sports Hall of Fame
summary: At a fundraising event, Mayor Sandy Stimpson underscored Mobile’s opportunity to capitalize on its sports legacy.
body: At a fundraising event held at Atchison Home, Mayor Sandy Stimpson appealed to those in attendance to help underwrite the Mobile Sports Hall of Fame Museum and underscored Mobile’s opportunity to capitalize on its sports legacy.
